tools.name: rebuy_recommended_products
tools.description: Return the highest-converting cross-sell products for a product, collection or cart context. Rebuy API: GET /api/v1/products/recommended.

tools.name: rebuy_top_sellers
tools.description: Return the store's top-selling products, optionally scoped to products. Rebuy API: GET /api/v1/products/top_sellers.

tools.name: rebuy_trending_products
tools.description: Return the products trending now for the store. Rebuy API: GET /api/v1/products/trending_products.

tools.name: rebuy_purchased_products
tools.description: Return products a given shopper bought before. Rebuy API: GET /api/v1/products/purchased.

tools.name: rebuy_collection_products
tools.description: Return the products in one or more Shopify collections, with optional smart sorting. Rebuy API: GET /api/v1/products/collections.

tools.name: rebuy_viewed_products
tools.description: Return products a shopper viewed, from Rebuy's view events. Rebuy API: GET /api/v1/products/viewed.

tools.name: rebuy_viewed_related_products
tools.description: Return products that complement what a shopper viewed. Rebuy API: GET /api/v1/products/viewed-related.

tools.name: rebuy_static_products
tools.description: Return a fixed, merchant-curated product list by product id, handle or collection. Rebuy API: GET /api/v1/products/static.

tools.name: rebuy_similar_products
tools.description: Return products similar to the given products. Rebuy API: GET /api/v1/products/similar_products.

tools.name: rebuy_custom_ruleset_products
tools.description: Run one of the store's custom recommendation rulesets for a cart or product context. Rebuy API: GET /api/v1/custom/id/{ruleset_id}.
